requirements.evidence: raw sampled frames, reverse/shuffled seeks; finite evidence only

requirements.description: Decoded sample peak at most -1 dBFS
requirements.evidence: decoded PCM sample peak, not true-peak or loudness

requirements.description: Text has at least 36px horizontal and 18px vertical safe margins
requirements.evidence: all-frame rasterizer text bounds; assumes telemetry is honest

requirements.description: All text at least 20px
requirements.evidence: instrumented font size in output pixels; not perceived legibility

requirements.description: Declared text/backing contrast at least 4.5
requirements.evidence: declared text/background contrast; overlapping artwork not modeled

requirements.description: Decoded frame MAE below 8
requirements.evidence: sampled encoded pixels vs renderer pixels; 0..255 MAE

requirements.description: At least 16 planned scene windows; not semantic variety
requirements.evidence: declared timeline windows, not detected cuts or narrative quality

requirements.description: At least 8 declared visual mechanisms; not quality
requirements.evidence: declared mechanisms; repeated code paths may look similar, inspect actual output

requirements.description: At least 120 seconds of synthesized speech placements
requirements.evidence: sum of separately synthesized phrase durations; not ASR or speech quality

requirements.description: Caption windows agree with synthesized phrase placements
requirements.evidence: caption vs synthesized phrase placement; no forced alignment or pronunciation validation

requirements.description: Explanatory phrases represented in text telemetry
requirements.evidence: all-frame instrumented text trace; not OCR, not proof against occlusion

requirements.description: Scene starts fall on the declared beat grid
requirements.evidence: declared scene cuts vs declared beat grid; not detected audio onsets

requirements.description: Similar production ambition: coherent argument, visual progression, purposeful motion, varied compositions; compare actual videos, not scores.
